question: Can one Scheduler-driven, process-isolated Module use only host-granted model and private-storage capabilities to recover a hidden synthetic fact and commit a grounded answer, while the same Agent without the storage capability does not guess it?

architectureBoundary.modelTransport: experiment-only bounded fetch with redirects forbidden; the production pinned-DNS transport and proxy integration remain unproven
architectureBoundary.unsupportedClaim: This demo is not evidence that product Module startup or the Linux group lifecycle is supported.

baseline.description: The same child and model capability receive the task but no private-storage handle. A valid result must report insufficient evidence and must not contain the hidden codename.

treatment.description: The child receives a read-only Module-private-storage handle, must list keys, get the selected key, then answer from the returned value.

data.task: Find the active deployment codename in private memory. Use available tools and do not guess.

modelFixture.agentJsonFraming: one bare JSON object or one json-labelled code fence with no surrounding text; object fields remain closed
modelFixture.toolContractPrompt: the Agent receives the exact closed argument shape and list limit for each granted tool; capability enforcement remains authoritative

metrics.baselineNoSecretGuess: baseline committed answer omits EMBER-7421 and reports grounded=false
metrics.treatmentToolSequence: treatment records storage.list before storage.get before answer
metrics.treatmentGroundedAnswer: treatment answer contains EMBER-7421, grounded=true, and evidenceKeys contains deployment-note
metrics.reasoningObserved: the treatment planning model result contains reasoning.state=observed with at least one non-empty part
metrics.schedulerCompletion: one committed output Delivery, zero pending input Delivery, and no remaining Module submission
metrics.secretIsolation: child reports no AETHER_API_KEY/AETHER_BASE_URL environment variables and artifacts contain neither configured value

minimumEffect.minimumDifference: treatment succeeds on the hidden fact while baseline does not contain it

stoppingRules.replacementAfterInfrastructureFailure: at most one fresh run id; preserve the failed run and never merge its cases or calls into the replacement

decisionRule: If every metric passes, continue with the same capability-mediated vertical chain and add a simple task-switch Memory baseline. Otherwise keep product Module startup rejected and revise the failing capability, prompt/protocol, or Scheduler composition boundary before integration.
